name: MiniMax H3 — text to video + audio (4-step turbo)
description:
Type a prompt and MiniMax H3 generates a short video **with a matching audio track** — no input image needed. Describe the scene, what happens over time, the camera move, and the sounds you want to hear.

This bundle runs the 4-step turbo LoRA, which makes it roughly 4x faster than the plain 20-step path with no other change. Leave "Fast mode" on for classroom use; turn it off if you want the slower, higher-fidelity 20-step render.

Size and length drive the cost far more than anything else — the time grows roughly with width x height x frames. 848x480 at 124 frames (about 5 s at 24 fps) is a good default; 1344x768 is the resolution the turbo LoRA was trained at and looks better, but takes noticeably longer. Frame count snaps to the model's own grid, so a nearby value may be used.
